description:
Fetch a full article by id.

The body/summary returned is gated by license_note:
  - full (default): body included
  - summary-only: no body, summary (summary/summary_en) present
  - link-only: link and metadata only, no summary or body

Args:
    id: article id (e.g. "news-20260702-4c769f")
    include_body: false to return metadata only, omitting the body (even when license is full)

Returns:
    The article's full metadata + body (body_policy states which policy was applied).
    Returns {error: "not_found", id} if the article does not exist.
name: portal_get
